desc:
🐅 Major Update! Dong Saming Phrai 🐅

🚣 Take a boat ride into the dense forest. This new area is almost as large as the main map.
⛏️ Dig the mysterious pit to definitely obtain a rare or higher-grade artifact. Chance to get a mythical or secret item!
⚔️ The forest is now a PvP zone. Leave the forest as soon as possible!
👑 The Wolf Leader Boss appears every 15 minutes. Team up to fight and earn Legendary-level rewards!
🧙 Secret Witch Hut: x4 Power Training + 4 Witch Arts
🙏 Put your hands together when chanting spells and using techniques

🔍 Monk Simulator
Search for amulets across the map, distinguish between authentic and fake items, buy and sell, and collect rare amulets.
🧘 Practice skills at the temple / Black Sect Academy
🎲 Random Family & Talents, boosting Immortal Power
📢 Press the circular button under the Shop in the game to see what you need to do.
📘 Press F3 to open the in-game manual
